title: AI SaaS Starter
summary: An open-source starter for AI SaaS products on FastAPI and Next.js: workspaces with tested tenant isolation, cited answers over documents, Stripe billing, background jobs, and a setup script that removes the modules you don't need.
contributionSummary: Designed and wrote the starter, its tests, and its CI.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Most AI SaaS products need the same foundation before the first real feature: sign-in, workspaces and roles, a safe way to keep each customer's data apart, billing, and a reliable way to call a model over the customer's own documents. This starter provides that foundation, taken from patterns proven in AnswerVera.

sections.title: What was built
paragraphs: A FastAPI backend and a Next.js web app, with modules toggled by a setup script.
bullets: Workspaces with owner, admin and member roles, and expiring single-use invites
A tenant-isolation test that calls every API route as an outsider and requires a 404
Document upload, pgvector search, and streamed answers with verified citations, from Claude or any OpenAI-compatible server
A usage ledger with per-workspace AI budgets
Stripe billing with signed, deduplicated webhooks
A Postgres job queue with retries, and email through Resend
English, Turkish and Arabic, including a right-to-left layout

sections.title: My contribution
paragraphs: I designed and wrote the starter, its test suite, and the CI that checks every combination of modules.
